name: Miracle Tor
source:
A legendary dark witch of extraordinary prowess, one of few mages with Magic Lv 3.
Her formidable power is undeniable despite her relative obscurity, stemming from an extended retreat into seclusion for rigorous training.

As an associate of Patton, Miracle joins forces with the Revolutionary Army.
With unwavering conviction, she boldly proclaims her ultimate ambition: to conquer the world and ascend as the paramount ruler of a united realm. This aspiration persists even within the ranks of the Revolutionary Army.

[Translated and edited from the official site]
